title: Molecular docking and simulation studies of Curcumin derivatives against COX-2 in Alzheimer's Disease
author: Arya Padture
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Retrieve curcumin derivatives
steps.instruction: Search the PubChem database for curcumin derivatives with at least 90 % structural similarity, download all hits, and record that the query returned 2561 compounds.

steps.title: Prepare COX‑2 target structure
steps.instruction: Download the crystal structure of cyclooxygenase‑2 (PDB ID 6COX), locate the inhibitor binding site, and define a grid box covering that site for subsequent site‑directed docking.

steps.title: Dock ligands with AutoDock Vina
steps.instruction: Run a Perl script that iterates over the 2561 ligand files and calls AutoDock Vina for each, using the previously defined grid box; collect the generated output files that contain the docking scores for every ligand.

steps.title: Extract and analyze docking scores
steps.instruction: Execute a Python script to parse the AutoDock Vina output files, extract the docking scores, write the scores to a text file, then open the text file in Excel for further analysis and ranking of ligands.

steps.title: Visualize top ligand complexes
steps.instruction: Load the protein‑ligand complexes of the 20 ligands with the best docking scores into PyMOL, generate visual representations of each complex, and save the optimal binding configurations for later examination.
